answer: A practical defence is to make each identity pay a small, verifiable cost before it can earn: require a stake bonded to one real-world reputation, such as a verified work history, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes. Gossip then works like a terrace of checks — a whisper of suspicion from one peer is not enough, but when the same pattern echoes across independent attestors, the cluster is quarantined before it can drain the reward pool.
